findings.evidence: The repo's established idiom for this material is exactly a family of prime discriminants with pairwise coprimality: `Prime/Discriminant/Independence.lean:91` `squarefree_prod_primeDiscriminantRadicands_of_pairwise_isCoprime {D : ι → ℤ} (hD : ∀ i, IsPrimeDiscriminant (D i)) (hcop : ∀ i ∈ S, ∀ j ∈ S, i ≠ j → IsCoprime ...)`, and similarly at lines 68 and 101. The new file departs from it.
findings.fix: Add the general theorem `theorem isFundamentalDiscriminant_prod {D : ι → ℤ} (hD : ∀ i ∈ s, IsPrimeDiscriminant (D i)) (hcop : ∀ i ∈ s, ∀ j ∈ s, i ≠ j → IsCoprime (D i) (D j)) : IsFundamentalDiscriminant (∏ i ∈ s, D i)`, proved by partitioning `s` on `IsEvenPrimeDiscriminant (D i)` (coprimality forces at most one such index, since `2` divides every even prime discriminant) and discharging the two parts with the current theorems, which become lemmas. `IsPrimeDiscriminant.isFundamentalDiscriminant` is then the singleton case.
findings.issue: Under-generalized main results. The synthesis direction is only available in the pre-split forms `∏ i ∈ s, oddPrimeDiscriminant (p i)` and `e * ∏ i ∈ s, oddPrimeDiscriminant (p i)`. The docstring asserts "Every product of pairwise coprime prime discriminants is of one of these two shapes" but that reduction is never proved, so a caller holding a family of prime discriminants (the shape the genus-field layer actually produces: the prime discriminants dividing `disc K`) must redo the even/odd split by hand.

findings.evidence: grep: `Independence.lean:64:private theorem Squarefree.int_neg {n : ℤ} (hn : Squarefree n) : Squarefree (-n)` and `FundamentalDiscriminant.lean:138:private theorem squarefree_neg {n : ℤ} ...`; `mathlib/Mathlib/Algebra/Squarefree/Basic.lean:87 Associated.squarefree_iff`.
findings.fix: Prove it once and publicly, at the general level: `theorem Squarefree.neg [Monoid R] [HasDistribNeg R] {n : R} (hn : Squarefree n) : Squarefree (-n)` via `(Associated.neg_left_iff.mpr (Associated.refl n)).squarefree_iff`, place it in a shared file, and delete both private copies.
findings.issue: `private theorem squarefree_neg` duplicates `private theorem Squarefree.int_neg` in `Prime/Discriminant/Independence.lean:64` — same statement, same three-line proof — and both are special cases of the general `Associated.squarefree_iff`.

findings.evidence: Line 116-121: `theorem odd_prod_oddPrimeDiscriminant ... : ¬ (2 : ℤ) ∣ ∏ i ∈ s, oddPrimeDiscriminant (p i)`.
findings.fix: State `Odd (∏ i ∈ s, oddPrimeDiscriminant (p i))` (derivable from the `% 4 = 1` lemma via `Int.odd_iff`), and if the divisibility form is needed internally, obtain it from `Int.not_even_iff_odd`/`Int.even_iff_two_dvd`.
findings.issue: `odd_prod_oddPrimeDiscriminant` is named for `Odd` but its statement is `¬ (2 : ℤ) ∣ ∏ ...`. The name promises the standard Mathlib predicate; the conclusion is a weaker-looking divisibility form callers must convert themselves.

summary: The two main theorems are stated at a shape-specific level (`e * ∏ oddPrimeDiscriminant (p i)`) rather than the natural family-of-prime-discriminants level that the file's own docstring claims to cover and that the rest of the Multiquadratic directory already uses; a private helper also duplicates an existing private helper in the same directory.
